verdict.rationale: Muse's first-party safety blog documents a settings switch that opts your data out of model training entirely, and a Forget skill to remove specific information. These are privacy controls close to the story, but neither is a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. Missing for 10: an explicit opt-out for telemetry/analytics and usage tracking, documentation of what usage data is collected, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the switches work.
